professionalSummary: Associate product manager with eight years in the product organization at Kestrel Messaging, specializing in messaging APIs.
Experienced in writing specifications, conducting developer discovery interviews, and tracking feature adoption using analytics tools.
experienceHighlights: Associate product manager on messaging API since March 2024, responsible for API specifications and adoption tracking.
Authored specifications and acceptance criteria for message‑status webhooks with the API engineering squad, maintaining them throughout development.
Conducted 14 discovery interviews with developer customers, synthesizing findings into research notes.
Implemented adoption tracking for webhook feature in Amplitude, reporting weekly active integrations to the product director.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Specification for message‑status webhooks, including event types, payload examples, retry and back‑off rules, acceptance criteria, and engineering lead review comments.

They do not provide evidence of the candidate’s overall tenure of five years in product management or of two years specifically on API or developer‑facing products beyond the documented period from March 2024 to August 2026.
